segments.text: Ok so this is the governed action approval page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the only agent code here is for LangGraph, nothing for Antigravity.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
The Antigravity agent wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. The approval card shows, but after tapping reject, the card stays and no reply comes.
So basically, reject should get a reply saying the email wasn't sent, but the agent is LangGraph only, and the reject never completes.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
